title: Metric results for dyadic approximation on the middle-third Cantor set
summary: Let $C$ be the middle-third Cantor set and $μ$ be the Cantor-Lebesgue measure on $C$. A conjecture of Velani states that $μ(W_2(τ))=0$ if $τ>1$ and $μ(W_2(τ))=1$ if $0 \frac{1}γ-\frac{1-γ}{3-γ}\,(\approx 1.429)$ and $0 \frac{1}γ-\frac{0.078(1-γ)}{γ(2-γ)}\approx 1.552$, due to Allen, Baker, Chow, and Yu (2023)) and the full measure part ($0<τ\leq 0.01$, due to Baker (2025)).
